scripts.title: Odalie Brask vs Petra Lindqvane
scripts.prompt: Compare Odalie Brask's streams to Petra Lindqvane — week on week, month on month and year on year.
scripts.answer: Odalie Brask is ahead on every horizon and the gap is widening: +31% month on month against +4% for Petra Lindqvane, driven by UK and France.

scripts.title: Quillfern vs Larchway · UK share
scripts.prompt: What's Quillfern's share of UK streams this quarter compared to Larchway, and how has it changed since last quarter?
scripts.answer: Quillfern holds 12.4% of UK streams in Q3, up from 10.9% in Q2. Larchway fell from 9.8% to 8.1% over the same period — most of the movement is the Altamere switch on 1 Sep.

explainer.title: How this was answered
explainer.text: Market share = distributor's capped streams ÷ all UK capped streams · attribution: distributor of record (policy v3) · Q3 = W27–W39 · release 2026-W42-v2 · one of three Annex G methods; switch to rights-owner view in Data

consistencyNotes_FOR_THE_DESIGNER: Script 'restated': the tile says net −3,114 but Glass Orchard going 26,000 -> 0 would add another −26,000. The Figma frame does not show the Δ column values. Decide which is intended. If −3,114 is net, make Glass Orchard 'Was 0 / Now 0' (re-flagged, no stream change) or change the tile.

Script 'uk-share': Q3 totals imply about 1.195bn UK streams in the quarter (148.2m / 12.4%). The Country page shows 412.3M UK capped streams in ONE week, so a quarter would be about 5.3bn. Scale one of them before showing both to stakeholders.
Script 'odalie-vs-petra': W42 streams 8,423,322 is for UK + FR + DE, but the Country page says Odalie Brask alone has 8.41M in the UK. Align the numbers.
